steps.sentence: His grandmother is very old; she is ___ of health.

meaning.hinglish: Woh chaand ki roshni mein kaam kar raha hai.

steps.sentence: She was wearing black clothes from ___.

meaning.hinglish: Usne sir se pair tak kaale kapde pehne the.

text.hi: किसी की कही बात अपने शब्दों में बताना = indirect speech। Seema asked Geeta, "What are you doing today?" → Seema asked Geeta what she was doing that day। बदलाव: am → was, I → she, today → that day, will → would।
text.hinglish: Kisi ki kahi baat apne shabdon mein bataana = indirect speech. Seema asked Geeta, "What are you doing today?" → Seema asked Geeta what she was doing that day. Badlaav: am → was, I → she, today → that day, will → would.
text.en: Telling what someone said in your own words is indirect speech. Seema asked Geeta, "What are you doing today?" → Seema asked Geeta what she was doing that day. Changes: am → was, I → she, today → that day, will → would.

prompt.hi: बदलो: Geeta said, "I am going to my grandmother's place."
prompt.hinglish: Badlo: Geeta said, "I am going to my grandmother's place."
prompt.en: Change: Geeta said, "I am going to my grandmother's place."

steps.answer: Geeta said that she was going to her grandmother's place.

meaning.hi: गीता ने कहा कि वह अपनी दादी के घर जा रही थी।
meaning.hinglish: Geeta ne kaha ki woh apni daadi ke ghar ja rahi thi.

prompt.hi: बदलो: Seema asked, "How far is your grandmother's house?"
prompt.hinglish: Badlo: Seema asked, "How far is your grandmother's house?"
prompt.en: Change: Seema asked, "How far is your grandmother's house?"

steps.answer: Seema asked how far her grandmother's house was.

meaning.hi: सीमा ने पूछा कि उसकी दादी का घर कितनी दूर था।
meaning.hinglish: Seema ne poochha ki uski daadi ka ghar kitni door tha.

prompt.hi: बदलो: Geeta said, "It is not very far. I will have to take a bus to Sonpur village."
prompt.hinglish: Badlo: Geeta said, "It is not very far. I will have to take a bus to Sonpur village."
prompt.en: Change Geeta's words into indirect speech.

steps.answer: Geeta said that it was not very far and she would have to take a bus to Sonpur village.

meaning.hi: गीता ने कहा कि वह ज़्यादा दूर नहीं था और उसे सोनपुर गाँव के लिए बस लेनी पड़ेगी।
meaning.hinglish: Geeta ne kaha ki woh zyaada door nahi tha aur use Sonpur gaon ke liye bus leni padegi.

prompt.hi: बदलो: Seema said, "Sonpur is a nice village. I have seen it."
prompt.hinglish: Badlo: Seema said, "Sonpur is a nice village. I have seen it."
prompt.en: Change Seema's words into indirect speech.

steps.answer: Seema said that Sonpur was a nice village and she had seen it.

meaning.hi: सीमा ने कहा कि सोनपुर एक अच्छा गाँव था और उसने उसे देखा था।
meaning.hinglish: Seema ne kaha ki Sonpur ek achha gaon tha aur usne use dekha tha.

text.hi: आदमी या लड़का = he, औरत या लड़की = she, जो दोनों हो सकते हैं (baby, teacher) = he/she, चीज़ें = it।
text.hinglish: Aadmi ya ladka = he, aurat ya ladki = she, jo dono ho sakte hain (baby, teacher) = he/she, cheezein = it.
text.en: A man or boy = he, a woman or girl = she, words that can be either (baby, teacher) = he/she, things = it.

instruction.hi: हर शब्द को he, she, he/she या it में रखो
instruction.hinglish: Har shabd ko he, she, he/she ya it mein rakho
instruction.en: Put each word under he, she, he/she or it
